_comment: Limits for the linode (Akamai) cloud-init recipe target. Sized for Linode 4 GB (the wizard-recommended floor; Nanode 1 GB is below minimum). Schema in deputyctl/src/limits.rs.

limitations.reason: Linode instances have no audio device; voice features disabled
limitations.unblock: deploy on rpi5 8GB+ or x86_64-mini-pc for voice

limitations.reason: We don't ship a signed Linode image; the cloud-init recipe pulls the deputyOS bundle at first boot
limitations.unblock: verify the recipe SHA before applying

limitations.reason: Updates are full re-image cycles (delete + redeploy via StackScript / cloud-init)
limitations.unblock: deputyctl update on this target prints a redeploy instruction (M4)

limitations.reason: RAM tier 'standard' (4 GB) below local-LLM threshold (8 GB)
limitations.unblock: scale to Linode 8 GB+ or use a cloud model provider
